This needs WebGPU

Your browser does not expose WebGPU.

Dendrite Garden runs its neurons on the graphics card, through WebGPU. As of November 2026 it has run in Microsoft Edge 157 and Firefox 148 on Windows 11 with an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060; other browsers and graphics cards have not been tried.

The original Dendrite Garden runs on any browser.
